name: 02a long ! output is not truncated for the model
02c pre_tool hooks do not see a ! command
02d a ! command that changes a file takes no checkpoint
02e a ! command needs a model provider
02f shell text is expanded as references
old: const expanded = turn.shell || turn.tool ? { prompt: input, notices: [] } : await expandReferences(input, cwd, redact, resourceReader);
new: const expanded = turn.tool ? { prompt: input, notices: [] } : await expandReferences(input, cwd, redact, resourceReader);

name: 02g a lone ! runs an empty command
old: if (text.startsWith('!') && text.slice(1).trim()) return void controller.submit(text.slice(1).trim(), { shell: true, display: text });
new: if (text.startsWith('!')) return void controller.submit(text.slice(1).trim(), { shell: true, display: text });

name: 02h permissions are not consulted for a ! command (already caught before)

old: if (status === 'denied') return finish('refused', working, '', `${tool.name === 'run_command' ? 'The command' : tool.name} was not run.`);
new: if (false) return finish('refused', working, '', `${tool.name === 'run_command' ? 'The command' : tool.name} was not run.`);
